games.name: ARK: Survival Ascended
games.safeRouteHint: Use the official CurseForge mod browser — sanctioned everywhere except vanilla official servers; avoid loose-file mods on BattlEye servers.

games.name: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon
Chivalry 2
games.safeRouteHint: No offline mode and EAC on all official play — mods exist only via the community Unchained launcher on unofficial servers; no documented bans, no official blessing.

games.name: Dark Messiah of Might and Magic
Dark Souls II: Scholar of the First Sin
games.safeRouteHint: Mod in offline mode only — the server flags any injected DLL, not just cheats; even overlays have triggered soft bans online.

games.name: Dark Souls III
games.safeRouteHint: Use Mod Engine's Forced Offline and alternate-save modes; restore vanilla files before returning online.

games.name: Dark Souls: Prepare to Die Edition
EA SPORTS College Football 27
games.safeRouteHint: EA's user agreement prohibits modifying their games. Offline single-player modding is widely tolerated; online modes are not. This game ships EA's kernel-level anti-cheat and the launcher cannot turn it off.

games.name: Elden Ring
games.safeRouteHint: Mod offline with EAC disabled (or use Seamless Co-op for multiplayer); never carry modded files or saves into vanilla online play.

games.name: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time
games.safeRouteHint: Pak mods are solo-safe (EAC isn't needed offline) and the game blocks modded crossplay itself; no bans documented.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition
Grand Theft Auto V (Legacy, single-player)
games.safeRouteHint: Single-player modding is long-established — never enter GTA Online with mods installed.

games.name: Helldivers 2
games.safeRouteHint: No offline mode exists — GameGuard always runs; cosmetic mods are tolerated so far but unsupported, and a flag won't be reversed.

games.name: Left 4 Dead 2
games.safeRouteHint: Workshop and VPK mods never trigger VAC — official servers just disable them; only injected code risks a ban.

games.name: Marvel Rivals
games.safeRouteHint: Always-online with file-integrity checks — mods are blocked, against the terms of service, and there is no offline sandbox.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty - Master Collection Version
Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater - Master Collection Version
Monster Hunter Wilds
games.safeRouteHint: Cosmetic and offline mods have a clean record; DLC-unlocker mods and modded content in multiplayer have drawn documented permanent bans.

games.name: Monster Hunter: World
games.safeRouteHint: Huge mod scene, near-zero ban history — keep gameplay-altering mods out of multiplayer.

games.name: Palworld
games.safeRouteHint: No anti-cheat — mod freely in solo or on your own server; keep mods off official and other people's servers.

games.name: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Enhanced Edition
games.saveDirHint: <home>/AppData/LocalLow/Owlcat Games/Pathfinder Wrath Of The Righteous/Saved Games

games.name: Phasmophobia
games.safeRouteHint: Kinetic's Code of Conduct bans file mods in all lobby types — offline singleplayer avoids servers, but reconnecting with a modified save risks your account.

games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.safeRouteHint: Mod story mode only — never take mods into Red Dead Online; file mods there draw account bans.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim VR
The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition
V Rising
games.safeRouteHint: BepInEx mods are fine in solo and on private servers; official servers are the only no-mod zone.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
games.safeRouteHint: Officially moddable via Steam Workshop — private Operations lobbies only; modded installs are locked out of public matchmaking, not banned.
